verdict.rationale: Automation is a fair axis for a package manager and OS-configuration system, but the evidence pack does not document any Nix feature for defining event-triggered rules or actions. Community mentions of auto-gc and of configuring systemd services describe an adjacent scheduled maintenance task and the host platform's facilities, not a Nix event-rule capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
